title: Terminal
targetsFailed: Could not load the project list. Hide and reopen to try again.
serverError: The terminal hit an error on the machine. Reconnect if the screen stops updating.
pasteTooLarge: Pasted content is too large (16 MiB max).

unlock.title: Unlock terminal
unlock.description: Enter your Crew sign-in password. One unlock lasts 12 hours for this sign-in session.

closed.title: Terminal session disconnected
closed.hint: The tmux session on the machine stays unless it exited; reconnect to pick up where you left off.
closed.targetMissing: This project is not ready on this machine
closed.targetMissingHint: Close this tab and open another project, or set the project up again on the Machines page.
closed.forbiddenHint: Your sign-in expired or the account is no longer an owner. Reload the page to sign in again.
closed.connectFailedHint: Several tries could not reach {{host}}. Check that the machine is on and in Tailscale, then press Reconnect.

emptyHint: Pick a project to open a terminal. You can open several projects, one tab each.

machines.title: Sessions on machines
machines.hint: tmux sessions alive on each Mac, including ones opened from another browser or machine. Closing a tab does not end the session.
machines.empty: No session is running on the machines.
machines.unreachable: Could not reach this machine (off or SSH error).
machines.failed: Could not load sessions on machines.
